interface.name: delete_category
interface.title: Delete Store Category
interface.description: Permanently removes one category from the store, identified by its category id.
whenToUse: The merchant explicitly asks to delete a category and has confirmed which one, e.g. 'remove the Clearance category'.
whenNotToUse: The merchant only wants a category hidden from the storefront -- use update_category to set status to hidden instead.
The merchant has not named a specific category -- use list_categories first and confirm before deleting anything.

categoryId.description: Id of the category to delete, as returned by list_categories.

id.description: The id of the deleted category.

deleted.description: True once the category is gone.

http.summary: Delete Category -- remove a category from the store by id.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing or does not carry the categories.read_write scope, so nothing was deleted.
No category exists with this id -- it may already have been deleted, so nothing was changed.

rules.message: categoryId must be a numeric category id

dependencies.reason: the category id to delete comes from list_categories
